clue.text: Port as new as it could be

indicators.note: the words before are shown in whatever order they could take, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone praises a harbour town as being as good as new.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as it could be' rearranges ASNEWAS. SWANSEA is a port in south Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Swansea is a Welsh harbour city, an example of a port.

clue.text: Mediterranean island sausages

explanation.surface: A menu offers cured meats from a holiday island.
explanation.definitionFit: Salamis is a Greek island near Athens; salamis are spicy cured Italian sausages.

clue.text: Risk coming over river

parts.note: an advent is an arrival or coming
the Ure is a Yorkshire river, a crossword regular

explanation.surface: Someone takes a gamble crossing a river in flood.
explanation.definitionFit: An adventure is a hazardous undertaking, a venture involving danger.

clue.text: Only about five crack

indicators.note: about means going round, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: sole means only, as in sole survivor
V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: Only about five people managed to crack the code.
explanation.definitionFit: To crack a puzzle is to work it out, to find its answer.

clue.text: A striver? I might be

indicators.note: might be says the letters could form something else, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as letters for the rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone ambitious wonders whether they are a social climber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'might be' rearranges ASTRIVERI; the whole clue also describes the answer, a social climber being a striver.
explanation.definitionFit: An arriviste is an ambitious newcomer pushing for status, the very type of striver.

clue.text: Clumsily assembled, worked at last

explanation.surface: Something was put together badly, but finally got working.
explanation.walkthrough: A last is a shoemaker's foot-shaped block, so 'worked at last' is shoemaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Cobbled together means made roughly; a cobbler mends shoes on a last.

clue.text: Men in force reported in the wood

indicators.note: reported signals a word heard spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: cops are police officers, men in the police force

explanation.surface: Police officers have been sighted among the trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A copse is a small wood of trees or bushes.

clue.text: Board supporting literary efforts

parts.note: a plank that holds up books, rather than a committee backing writers

explanation.surface: A committee funds writers' projects.
explanation.definitionFit: A shelf is a board fixed to a wall, and books are literary works resting on it.

clue.text: Not a nice person left on the river

parts.note: the Ouse is a river in Yorkshire, and another in East Anglia

explanation.surface: An unpleasant character has been abandoned on the riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: A louse is a contemptible person, a figurative sense of the parasite.

clue.text: Certainly not the original Adam furniture

explanation.surface: Some pieces are reproductions, not genuine Adam-style antiques.
explanation.walkthrough: Adam was the original man and went naked, hence no dresser; Adam is also a famous furniture style.
explanation.definitionFit: A dresser is someone who clothes themselves, unlike Eden's Adam, and a dresser is also a kitchen cabinet.

clue.text: Even when it's reversed, it's the same

indicators.text: when it's reversed, it's the same
indicators.note: this says the answer reads identically backwards, so it is a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A puzzle claims something remains unchanged even when flipped round.
explanation.definitionFit: Level means even, flat or equal.

clue.text: Copy special procedure

indicators.note: special suggests an unusual version of the word, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An office describes its special method for duplicating documents.
explanation.definitionFit: To reproduce something is to make a copy of it.

clue.text: Work on island plot

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the work follows the island

parts.note: the Isle of Man is an island between Britain and Ireland
oeuvre is a French word for a work of art

explanation.surface: Someone works on an island scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A manoeuvre is a scheme or crafty plan, a sense close to a plot.

clue.text: Measures going up and down in well, perhaps

definitions.text: going up and down in well, perhaps

explanation.surface: Someone measures things while climbing a well.
explanation.walkthrough: The well here is a stairwell.
explanation.definitionFit: Steps are measures taken to act; steps are also stairs climbing a stairwell.

clue.text: Channel needed for audition

explanation.surface: A singer needs a channel for a tryout.
explanation.walkthrough: Audition is used in its sense of hearing, not a tryout.
explanation.definitionFit: A sound is a narrow sea channel; sound is also what is heard by the ear.

clue.text: To ruin one good person is corrupt

parts.note: to dish someone's chances is to wreck them
ST, saint, is a holy person

explanation.surface: Bringing down a decent person is a wicked act.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishonest means lacking integrity, untrustworthy.

clue.text: Way workshop could be made more dignified

parts.note: ST, street, is a way
an atelier is an artist's or designer's workshop

explanation.surface: A route through a studio could be made grander.
explanation.definitionFit: Statelier is the comparative of stately, meaning grand and imposing.

clue.text: Fruitful vehicle for theatrical production

explanation.surface: A fruit cart doubles as a stage prop.
explanation.walkthrough: The Apple Cart is a play by George Bernard Shaw.
explanation.definitionFit: A cart carrying fruit, and the title of Shaw's political comedy.

clue.text: Fashionable translation? Just the opposite

parts.note: in means fashionable
a version is a rendering into another language

explanation.surface: A trendy translation turns out to say the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: An inversion is a turning upside down, a reversal of order.

clue.text: Fail to turn out as intended

definitions.text: Fail to turn out as intended

parts.words: Fail to turn out as intended
parts.note: read as failing to get out of bed on time, not as plans going wrong

explanation.surface: A project does not go according to plan.
explanation.definitionFit: To sleep beyond the planned waking time, so not rising when you meant to.

clue.text: Best available work two little boys assembled

parts.note: OP, opus, is a work
Tim and Al are short boys' names
Tim and Al are short boys' names

explanation.surface: A pair of youngsters put together the finest work they could.
explanation.definitionFit: Optimal means the most favourable, the best possible.

clue.text: At least ten in the game

explanation.surface: A team of at least ten takes the field.
explanation.walkthrough: Fives is a British handball game played against walls.
explanation.definitionFit: More than one five makes ten or more; fives is a court game hitting a ball by hand.

clue.text: His business depends on mounting consumer demands

definitions.text: His business depends on mounting consumer demands

parts.words: His business depends on mounting consumer demands
parts.note: read as riders needing equipment for mounting horses, not rising demand

explanation.surface: A trader relies on rising customer demand.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman making saddles depends on people who ride horses.

clue.text: Taking part in debate, MP overran time

indicators.note: Taking part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A politician talked for too long in a debate.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempo is the speed or timing of music, its time.

clue.text: One in a thousand — in a thousand, note

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the others

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A rare item turns out to be one in a thousand.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'in' puts I inside MINM; the second 'in' is part of the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A minim is a musical note, the half note of American usage.

clue.text: Like some boards, having fluctuating fortunes

explanation.surface: Something resembles a games board and has had ups and downs.
explanation.definitionFit: Draughts boards are checked in squares; a chequered career mixes success and failure.

clue.text: It could, it's said, be three spectators

definitions.text: It could, it's said, be three spectators

parts.words: It could, it's said, be three spectators
parts.note: refers to the proverb that two is company but three people is too many

explanation.surface: A tiny audience of three people watches.
explanation.definitionFit: A throng of onlookers, and the proverbial number three spoiling company.

clue.text: Leaders of unions label the right as politically extreme

indicators.note: leaders are the first letters of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Union bosses brand the right as extremist.
explanation.definitionFit: An ultra is a hardliner, someone holding extreme views.

clue.text: State of St Paul's main stone — terrible

indicators.note: terrible suggests the words are mangled, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The great stone of St Paul's Cathedral is in a dreadful condition.
explanation.walkthrough: St Paul's is the London cathedral in the surface, but St Paul is a US state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: St Paul is the capital city of Minnesota, a US state.

clue.text: Tis going to become material

explanation.surface: Something is about to turn into fabric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tis going to' means it is going to, the old contraction 'twill.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic contraction of 'it will'; twill is also a woven fabric with diagonal ribs.

clue.text: Restricted contribution from widow put in hat

indicators.note: put in says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: lid is slang for a hat
the widow's mite is the small coin given in the Gospel story

explanation.surface: A widow's donation is placed in a hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Limited means confined within bounds, constrained.

clue.text: Such a person coaches, perhaps, before the start of each run

definitions.text: Such a person coaches, perhaps, before the start of each run

parts.note: coaches are carriages that make up a train

indicators.note: the start is the first letter of the next word

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A coach puts athletes through drills before each run.
explanation.definitionFit: A coach in sport instructs and drills athletes.
